title: A shell opens a TCP connection to another address
threat_model: An attacker's shell connects out over a raw TCP connection, the shape of a reverse shell, without any application protocol.
notes: setup.sh starts a python listener bound to the machine's first non-loopback IPv4 address on a port it picks, and records the address and the port in files. The action runs bash -c with exec 3<>/dev/tcp/ADDRESS/PORT, which is a connect made by the shell within seconds of its exec. The scenario is not run if the machine has no such address.
